# Rename `_anthropic_cache_settings` to `_anthropic_cache_options`

## Context / Problem

`_anthropic_cache_settings` in `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py` returns a pydantic-ai
`ModelSettings` mapping (or `None` for non-Anthropic models), not a settings object. Readers
have twice mistaken it for a config accessor. Renaming it to `_anthropic_cache_options` makes
the return shape read correctly at every call site. This is a pure rename: no behaviour
changes, no signature change, no new capability.

## Approach

Rename the function at its definition, update the re-export and the call site, and update the
module docstring that names it. The old name must not survive anywhere, since a stale alias
would defeat the point of the rename.

## Scope

I went through the tree with `grep` and these are the files that mention it:

- `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py` — the definition (line 39) and the module docstring
  (line 10).
- `src/rebar/llm/runner.py` — the re-export import (line 28) and the single call site
  (line 337).

## Testing

Every acceptance criterion below is checked by a command that runs in-session and produces
observable output, so nothing is deferred to a later reviewer:

- `git grep -n _anthropic_cache_settings` must print nothing (exit 1).
- `git grep -n _anthropic_cache_options` must print the definition, the re-export and the call
  site.
- `make test` must pass, which exercises the renamed function through
  `tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `git grep -n _anthropic_cache_settings` prints nothing and exits 1 (the old name is gone
      from the whole tree, not just from `src/`)
- [ ] `_anthropic_cache_options` is defined in `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py`, re-exported
      from `src/rebar/llm/runner.py`, and called at the cache-settings site, verified by
      `git grep -n _anthropic_cache_options`
- [ ] the renamed function's behaviour is unchanged: it still returns the cache-control
      settings mapping for an `anthropic:` model and `None` for `openai:`/`google-gla:`/`""`
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck` and `make test` all pass
